text: Based on the data, tree-cover loss on the property has been relatively low in recent years. In 2021, there was a notable loss of 81.3 hectares, which is the highest in recent years. However, the loss significantly decreased to 0.6 hectares in 2022 and slightly increased to 4.5 hectares in 2023. While there was a spike in 2021, the overall trend in the last three years does not show a consistent increase in tree-cover loss.
